title: Company Profile PT Chakra Radha Mustika
tagline: A comprehensive digital presence for PT Chakra Radha Mustika
description: The "Company Profile PT Chakra Radha Mustika" project is a comprehensive digital representation of PT Chakra Radha Mustika, designed to showcase the company's services, achievements, and values. This project utilizes modern web development technologies to ensure a seamless and engaging user experience.
fullDescription:
Problem: PT Chakra Radha Mustika needed a modern, professional web presence to showcase their services, values, and company achievements to potential clients and partners. The existing online footprint was outdated and did not reflect the company's growth.

Solution: Built a responsive single-page company profile using Next.js with server-side rendering for SEO optimization. The site features smooth scroll navigation, a services section, company overview, and a contact form — all designed to convert visitors into leads.

Role: Led the frontend development from concept to deployment. Implemented the component architecture using React and Next.js, styled the entire interface with Tailwind CSS for rapid and consistent design, and configured Vercel deployment with proper metadata and Open Graph tags for social sharing.

Outcome: Delivered a fast, mobile-first company profile that loads under 2 seconds and scores 90+ on Lighthouse performance audits.

tools.title: React and Next.js
tools.desc: These powerful frameworks are employed to create a dynamic and responsive web application. React ensures a smooth and interactive user interface, while Next.js optimizes performance with server-side rendering and static site generation.

tools.title: Tailwind CSS
tools.desc: For styling, Tailwind CSS is used to create a visually appealing and consistent design across the website. Tailwind's utility-first approach allows for rapid development and customization, ensuring the company profile looks professional and modern.

techBreakdown.name: Next.js
techBreakdown.reason: Server-side rendering for SEO and fast initial page loads, critical for a company profile that needs to rank in search results.

techBreakdown.name: Tailwind CSS
techBreakdown.reason: Utility-first styling for rapid development of a consistent, professional design system without writing custom CSS from scratch.

techBreakdown.name: React
techBreakdown.reason: Component-based architecture for building reusable UI sections — hero, services, about, and contact — that are easy to maintain.

challenges.title: SEO Optimization for Single-Page Design
challenges.description: Single-page applications typically struggle with SEO since content is rendered client-side. Solved this by leveraging Next.js SSR to pre-render all sections on the server, adding proper meta tags and Open Graph data, resulting in full Google indexing.

challenges.title: Responsive Multi-Column Layouts
challenges.description: The company profile had complex multi-column layouts for services and team sections that needed to collapse gracefully on mobile. Used Tailwind's responsive prefixes and flexbox patterns to create a fluid layout that works across all viewport sizes.

title: XYZ Company Profile
tagline: A modern company profile with smooth animations
description: This project is a company profile for XYZ Company. The web application provides information about the company's history, team, services, and contact details. It is built using the latest web technologies to ensure a smooth and engaging user experience.
fullDescription:
Problem: XYZ Company needed to refresh their outdated corporate website with a modern, visually engaging experience that would leave a lasting impression on visitors and potential clients.

Solution: Built a polished company profile using Next.js with Chakra UI for a consistent component library, Framer Motion for smooth page transitions and scroll-triggered animations, and Redux Toolkit for managing UI state like theme toggles and navigation.

Role: Handled the full frontend development — designed and implemented the component architecture, integrated Framer Motion animation sequences for section reveals and hover effects, and set up Redux Toolkit slices for managing application-wide UI state.

Outcome: Delivered a visually striking, animated company profile that significantly reduced bounce rate and increased average session duration compared to the previous site.

title: The Blog
tagline: A full-featured blog platform with CRUD and pagination
description: Website Blog is a web application developed using Next.js framework, Chakra UI for styling, and Redux Toolkit for state management. It allows users to create, edit, and view blog posts. The application provides a user-friendly interface with features like pagination and responsive design.
fullDescription:
Problem: There was a need for a clean, performant blog platform that supports full CRUD operations — creating, reading, updating, and deleting posts — with user authentication and paginated content discovery.

Solution: Built a full-featured blog using Next.js with Chakra UI for a polished interface, Redux Toolkit for state management across auth and post data, Formik with Yup for validated forms, and js-cookie for session persistence.

Role: Developed the entire frontend — implemented cookie-based authentication flow, built the Redux slices for posts and user state, designed the paginated post listing with infinite scroll, and created the form system with Formik and Yup validation schemas.

Outcome: Delivered a fully functional blog platform where users can register, log in, create and edit posts, and browse content with smooth pagination.

title: Event Management
tagline: An MVP platform for creating, promoting, and attending events
description: The main goal of the MVP is to create a simple and functional event management platform that allows event organizers to create and promote events, while attendees can browse and register for those events.
fullDescription:
Problem: Event organizers lacked a simple, centralized platform to create, promote, and manage events while attendees needed an easy way to discover and register for events in their area.

Solution: Built an MVP event management platform using Next.js with a full Express.js backend, MySQL database with Prisma ORM, and TypeScript throughout. Features include event CRUD for organizers, a registration flow for attendees, search with filters, and role-based access control.

Role: Handled fullstack development — designed the Prisma schema for events, registrations, and users, built the Express.js REST API with authentication middleware, and implemented the Next.js frontend with Redux state management and Formik forms.

Outcome: Delivered a functional MVP platform that handles event creation, discovery, and registration with a clean separation between organizer and attendee experiences.

challenges.title: Role-Based Access Control

title: Resthere
tagline: Your Ideal Place to Rest — a hotel booking platform
description: RestHere is a user-friendly platform for booking hotels, villas, and homestays. Embracing a "stay for everyone" philosophy, we offer a clean and accessible design to ensure a seamless experience for all users. Whether you're traveling or staying local, RestHere helps you find and book the perfect place to rest with ease.
fullDescription:
Problem: Travelers struggle to find and book accommodations across scattered platforms — hotels, villas, and homestays each have their own booking systems, making it hard to compare options and find the best place to stay.

Solution: Built a unified booking platform using Next.js with Leaflet interactive maps, real-time property availability, Google OAuth for frictionless sign-in, and a multi-step booking flow. The platform embraces a "stay for everyone" philosophy with a clean, accessible design.

Role: Fullstack development using Agile methodology with two-week sprints tracked in Jira. Implemented the Express.js API with Prisma ORM, designed the MySQL schema, built the Redux state management with Thunk for async operations, and developed the frontend with Tailwind CSS.

Outcome: Delivered a complete booking platform that allows users to browse properties on an interactive map, check availability, and complete bookings — all within a seamless, responsive interface.

challenges.title: Complex Booking State Management
challenges.description: The multi-step booking flow (property selection → date picker → guest info → payment) required tracking partial data across steps without losing progress. Managed this with Redux Thunk middleware — each step dispatches async actions that validate and persist intermediate state, with a booking slice that resets on completion or cancellation.

challenges.title: Map Integration with Property Data
challenges.description: Syncing Leaflet map markers with filtered property results was challenging — when users zoom, pan, or apply filters, the map markers and list view needed to stay in sync. Solved by debouncing map move events and dispatching a Redux action that updates both the marker layer and the property list simultaneously.

title: Quiser
tagline: Simplifying your learning journey with interactive quizzes
description: Quiser: Simplifying Your Learning Journey. Quiser is an intuitive platform designed to create and manage quizzes effortlessly. Aimed at enhancing the learning experience, it offers a clean and user-friendly interface that allows users to focus on the content. Whether for education, training, or fun, Quiser enables the creation of engaging quizzes with ease.
fullDescription:
Problem: Creating and managing quizzes is tedious with existing tools — educators and trainers need a simple, engaging platform that handles quiz creation, taking, automatic grading, and performance tracking without the complexity of enterprise LMS systems.

Solution: Built an intuitive quiz platform using Next.js with Chakra UI and Tailwind CSS for a clean interface, Framer Motion for smooth question transitions, and custom React hooks for real-time quiz state management including timers and scoring.

Role: Focused on frontend development — designed the quiz-taking interface with animated transitions, implemented the scoring engine with automatic grading, built the responsive layout for mobile quiz-taking, and created the quiz creation form with Formik validation.

Outcome: Delivered a polished quiz platform where users can create, share, and take quizzes with smooth animations, real-time scoring, and a clean interface that works across all devices.

challenges.title: Quiz State Transitions
challenges.description: Managing real-time quiz state — timer countdown, answer selection, scoring logic, and transitions between questions — required careful orchestration to avoid losing progress. Built custom React hooks (useQuizTimer, useQuizScore) that encapsulate each concern, with a central useQuizState hook that coordinates question progression and persists partial results.

challenges.title: Smooth Animations Under Load

Optimized by using layout animations instead of AnimatePresence for question swaps, lazy-loading animation variants, and using will-change hints strategically to keep transitions at 60fps.
